purpose: Bounded reviewer-contract repair after canonical Qwen3-8B exact-head review run 34580396222 completed all six remote inference requests and canonical validation successfully, then published five blocking findings whose own reasons violate the already-pinned trusted direct-evidence policy. The policy explicitly forbids speculative findings and states that words such as could, may, might, likely, or potentially do not establish a defect; it also explicitly forbids classifying route/path/test-only strings as secrets, PII, or authorization bypasses merely because they exist. Add deterministic policy-admissibility enforcement plus one bounded model repair pass for an inadmissible candidate. An inadmissible candidate is never silently converted to PASS: it must be replaced by a fresh schema-valid, policy-admissible model response for the same exact chunk, otherwise the provider fails closed.

The published candidate reasons rely on speculative could/may/potentially language that the pinned policy expressly says does not establish a defect.
